findings.evidence: Diff lines 79–80 and 189: the proof bodies are exactly the base lemma applied to `f.hom g`.

findings.issue: `sheafedSpace_comp_map_apply` and `pullbackSection_comp_apply` (line 178) are public lemmas that only restate `sheafedSpace_map_apply` and `pullbackSection_apply` up to `hom_comp`; their proofs are `exact sheafedSpace_map_apply I d h (f.hom g) x` and `exact pullbackSection_apply e U (f.hom g) x`.

summary: The ringed descent of nodal isomorphisms is new, but `pullbackSection` rebuilds the existing `holomorphicStructureSheaf.precomp` (smoothness argument and ring laws) and its naturality instead of reusing `precomp`/`homOfContMDiff` through `quotientSheafι`. Two public `_comp_apply` lemmas are one-line restatements of their base lemmas.
